correctness.rationale: For every nondegenerate triangle, the three facet normals have a unique positive dependence. This makes each fixed-multiplier translation fiber exactly a homothetic triangle of area A(1−g)^2, and hence its four-dimensional integral is A area(F)/6. A feasible similarity gives a nonnegative 3-by-3 column-stochastic barycentric matrix with eigenvalues 1,z,conjugate(z); trace and trace-square inequalities force z into the equilateral root-of-unity triangle. Rotational symmetry proves sharpness and uniqueness. Homogeneous gauge sublevel areas give Beta(2,3). Exact steps and boundaries are independently reconstructed in RESULT.md; an independent numerical hull implementation passed 382 checks on 125 triangles and beta moments. The finite computations are not the proof.

value.rationale: The complete self-containment parameter body is a natural four-dimensional geometric object defined in recent algorithmic geometry, and its Lebesgue volume quantifies the whole space of feasible translations/scales/rotations rather than the single largest placement. The exact universal equilateral maximizer, sharp dimensionless bound, and shape-independent Beta(2,3) radial law give structural and statistical descriptions with direct geometric interpretation. This is not a routine renaming of the underlying 2026 algorithmic theorem.
